name: smashsend
description: SMASHSEND Email Marketing API for Claude: build email campaigns and newsletters with react-email, analyse open and click rates, edit email automation workflows, manage contacts, and add transactional email to your app.

api_key.title: SmashSend API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://smashsend.com/latest/settings/api-keys. Use a Viewer key for read-only analysis, or an Editor key to draft campaigns, edit workflow drafts and send transactional email.
